name: QVAULT
description: QVAULT ($QVLT) is a community-first protocol on Solana building finance for the post-quantum era. It combines a quantum-safe security thesis, real DeFi utility (staking, fee-sharing, buyback-and-burn) and on-chain DAO governance, with a long-term roadmap to a proprietary post-quantum Layer 1 using CRYSTALS-Dilithium signatures.
